tasks.label: ArduPilot: Configure ESP32-S3
args: export IDF_PYTHON_ENV_PATH=/Users/Fabian/.espressif/python_env/idf5.3_py3.10_env && export PATH="$IDF_PYTHON_ENV_PATH/bin:$PATH" && source modules/esp_idf/export.sh && ./waf configure --board=esp32s3devkit --debug

tasks.label: ArduPilot: Build Plane
args: export IDF_PYTHON_ENV_PATH=/Users/Fabian/.espressif/python_env/idf5.3_py3.10_env && export PATH="$IDF_PYTHON_ENV_PATH/bin:$PATH" && source modules/esp_idf/export.sh && ./waf plane

tasks.label: ArduPilot: Flash ESP32-S3
args: export IDF_PYTHON_ENV_PATH=/Users/Fabian/.espressif/python_env/idf5.3_py3.10_env && export PATH="$IDF_PYTHON_ENV_PATH/bin:$PATH" && python -m esptool --chip esp32s3 --port /dev/cu.usbmodem11301 write_flash @flash_args

tasks.label: ArduPilot: Start OpenOCD
args: pkill -x openocd 2>/dev/null || true; exec /Users/Fabian/.espressif/tools/openocd-esp32/v0.12.0-esp32-20240318/openocd-esp32/bin/openocd -s /Users/Fabian/.espressif/tools/openocd-esp32/v0.12.0-esp32-20240318/openocd-esp32/share/openocd/scripts -f board/esp32s3-builtin.cfg -c "adapter speed 1000" -c "init" -c "reset halt" -c "esp appimage_offset 0x20000"

tasks.label: ArduPilot: Start Serial Monitor
args: setopt null_glob; devices=(/dev/cu.usb*); if (( ${#devices[@]} == 0 )); then echo "No USB serial devices found."; exit 1; fi; echo "Select serial device:"; select device in "${devices[@]}"; do if [[ -n "$device" ]]; then echo "Opening $device at 115200 baud..."; exec python -m serial.tools.miniterm "$device" 115200 --raw; else echo "Invalid selection."; fi; done
